headline: Indian motorcycle manufacturers showcase new models at EICMA 2026
hook: Indian two-wheeler brands dominate global stage
summary: Indian two-wheeler companies showcased new product lineups and technological advancements at the EICMA 2026 motorcycle show in Milan, Italy. The event highlighted the growing global competitiveness of Indian-made motorcycles and electric vehicles. Major domestic players used the platform to signal expansion plans into international markets. This shift reflects the increasing integration of the Indian automotive industry into global supply chains.
why_it_matters: Export growth potential improves long-term outlook for Indian two-wheeler stocks.
winners_losers: Indian exporters gain / Global incumbents face competition

headline: Bajaj Auto informs exchange about postal ballot process
hook: Postal ballot notice issued for Bajaj Auto
summary: Bajaj Auto has officially notified the stock exchanges regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot conducted via remote e-voting. Shareholders will be able to cast their votes on specific resolutions as outlined in the postal ballot notice. This is a routine corporate governance filing required for listed entities seeking shareholder approval. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should check the specific resolutions being proposed.
why_it_matters: Check postal ballot resolutions for corporate governance decisions.

headline: India's auto retail sales rose 32% YoY in September, the highest ever
hook: Premium bike demand fuels sales surge
summary: In September, auto retail sales in India grew 32% year‑on‑year, the strongest monthly performance on record. Dealers attributed the rise to festive buying in early September, steady demand from rural and semi‑urban areas, and a shift toward premium motorcycles and electric vehicles. The surge signals stronger consumer spending and could boost earnings for manufacturers such as Hero MotoCorp, TVS Motor and Bajaj Auto. Retail investors may see improved revenue outlooks for these companies and related parts suppliers.
why_it_matters: Higher auto sales boost manufacturers' earnings

headline: Bajaj Auto surpasses Mahindra in electric three-wheeler sales
hook: Bajaj leads electric three-wheeler market share
summary: Electric three-wheeler registrations grew by 85.4% between January and October 2026. Bajaj Auto has overtaken Mahindra & Mahindra to claim the top spot in this segment. TVS Motor Company also recorded significant growth in market share during the same period. This shift highlights intensifying competition in the rapidly expanding electric commercial vehicle space.
why_it_matters: Bajaj gains competitive edge in the growing electric vehicle market.
winners_losers: Bajaj and TVS gain / Mahindra hurt

headline: Bajaj Auto sets target for 7.5 lakh quarterly exports
hook: Bajaj Auto eyes consistent quarterly export volumes
summary: Bajaj Auto has announced a strategic target to maintain quarterly export volumes at 7.5 lakh units. This move aims to stabilize the company's international revenue stream despite global market fluctuations. The company continues to focus on key export markets to sustain these figures. Indian retail investors should note this as a signal of management's confidence in global demand recovery.
why_it_matters: Export stability supports Bajaj Auto's long-term earnings growth.

headline: Bajaj Auto executive Rakesh Sharma notes growing demand for Pulsar
hook: Stronger momentum for the Pulsar brand
summary: Bajaj Auto's executive Rakesh Sharma stated that the revival of the Pulsar motorcycle brand is gaining real momentum. The commentary highlights ongoing demand trends within the company's core two-wheeler segment. Indian retail investors tracking auto sales and Bajaj Auto's market share in motorcycles can gauge brand performance from these executive insights.

hook: October data maps the EV two-wheeler race
summary: Recent October registration and sales data details the performance of major electric two-wheeler manufacturers in India, including TVS Motor, Bajaj Auto, Ather Energy, and Ola Electric. The figures reveal shifting market share dynamics as traditional automakers gain ground against pure-play EV startups during the festive season. Retail investors tracking the electric vehicle transition can gauge competitive positioning and volume growth trends across listed and unlisted players.
why_it_matters: EV market share shifts impact auto stock valuations
winners_losers: Traditional automakers gain / startups face pressure

headline: Bajaj Auto reports 14% increase in October sales
hook: Double-digit growth for Bajaj Auto in October
summary: Bajaj Auto recorded total sales of 554,692 units in October 2024, compared to 486,338 units in the same month last year. Domestic two-wheeler sales rose 16% to 355,705 units, while exports grew 11% to 183,011 units. Commercial vehicle sales saw a slight decline of 2% during the period. This performance reflects sustained demand during the festive season.
why_it_matters: Strong festive demand signals potential upside for auto stock valuations.
winners_losers: Bajaj Auto gains / Commercial vehicle segment lags

headline: Bajaj Auto reports 14% growth in October wholesales to 5,91,876 units
hook: Strong festival demand lifts Bajaj Auto
summary: Bajaj Auto announced its total wholesales reached 5,91,876 units in October, compared to 5,18,170 units during the same month last year. This represents a 14% year-on-year growth driven by robust festival demand. Strong monthly auto sales figures serve as a primary indicator of consumer demand and rural recovery for Indian retail investors.
whats_next: November sales numbers in early December
why_it_matters: Strong festive sales indicate solid domestic consumer demand for autos.

headline: Bajaj Auto works on new 250cc adventure bike
hook: Bajaj targets growing adventure motorcycle segment
summary: Bajaj Auto is preparing to introduce a new 250cc adventure motorcycle to its Indian product portfolio. The launch aims to strengthen the company's presence in the fast-growing premium adventure touring segment. This model will allow Bajaj to compete directly with existing quarter-liter motorcycle offerings in the domestic market. For retail investors, expanding into higher-margin premium bikes helps support average selling prices and overall profitability.
why_it_matters: Bajaj expands into higher-margin premium motorcycle market.
